preservedResponsibilities: Original GregorianCalendar is now concrete and implements status/default, locale, adopted zone with explicit/default locale, named const-reference zone constructor overloads, date/date-time, copy, assignment and clone. Constructor dispatch only represents declared C++ overloads; it does not infer a calendar type or parsing rule. Default/locale/zone forms evaluate source UTC getNow and setTime after base initialization even for a failed setter status; numeric date forms evaluate default-zone/default-locale arguments and set source fields without now. Copy construction and clone copy the five derived fields. Assignment clones base ownership and copies only the three cutover fields, retaining destination resolver flags in source write order (CALC-343). The native witness supplies distinct boolean resolver states to distinguish these contracts. Original Julian/Gregorian hybrid arithmetic, signed64 month starts, limits, precedence, checked normalization and cutover shifts remain unchanged. The reference factory is explicit because JS cannot overload pointer ownership by C++ constness; its tag preserves source clone timing in the actual base constructor.

Unchanged ICU78.3 library witnesses pass 14994 locale/week cases over 993 requested names and 1440 constructor/copy/weekend cases. They observe all six week/weekend fields, valid/actual Locale values and literal root IDs, incoming error/warning behavior, default and keyword timezone selection, reference/adoption clone counts, null/error and aliased-status clone callbacks, all initialized field/stamp/flag and derived state, date-versus-clock initialization, completed UTC fields and weekend work clones. Existing 63050 scalar/calendar and 12929 time cases also pass after fixtures use real constructors and explicit public controlled baselines.

AQF9AG retains original base month/year-length implementations and ordinal-month overload behavior while recognizing actual RuleBasedTimeZone in the existing wall-time path. All18 standard concrete calendars pass6426 native field cases; original shared factory passes15600 cases. The factory stays in a separate implementation fragment to avoid a base/derived ESM initialization cycle.
omittedResponsibilities: Custom ICU service registration, remaining unconsumed APIs (including general add/roll and custom cutover mutation), full LibreOffice formatter/column/CSV integration, native allocation/OOM/destructor/ABI/undefined or uninitialized memory and platform fake-clock facilities remain uncertified. The actual shared-cache factory and all18 standard calendar classes are now ported separately; their bounded native witnesses do not imply complete ICU/UNO certification.
